name: antigravity-notification-enhancer
description: Dynamic Windows notifications for Antigravity IDE: same-active-chat support, clean titles, RTL proxy chaining, and auto-repatch after IDE updates.

antigravityNotifications.enabled.description: Enable enhanced Antigravity notifications, clean titles, and webview proxy.

antigravityNotifications.notifyWhenFocus.description: Show Windows notifications even when the Antigravity IDE window is focused.

antigravityNotifications.notifySameActiv.description: Show notifications even while actively viewing the conversation that finished or asked for input.

antigravityNotifications.showOpenChatBan.description: Show the in-IDE 'Open Chat / Dismiss' corner banner when already viewing that chat.

antigravityNotifications.soundMode.description: Audio policy: respectPayload silences Windows chime if Antigravity MP3 already played.

antigravityNotifications.dedupeWindowMs.description: Duplicate notification suppression window in milliseconds (0 disables).

antigravityNotifications.autoPatchOnUpda.description: Automatically re-apply notification hooks when an Antigravity IDE update overwrites resources/app.

antigravityNotifications.promptReloadAft.description: Show a 'Reload Window' prompt button after auto-patching a new IDE version.

antigravityNotifications.finishedTitleTe.description: Line 1 template for finished agent notifications ({body}, {title}, {appName}).

antigravityNotifications.finishedBodyTem.description: Line 2 template for finished agent notifications (leave empty for clean single-line toast).
